PASS confirmed. The bugs in `src/stats.pl`:

1. **`mean`** divided by `scalar(@values) - 1` instead of `scalar(@values)`, so `mean(1, 2, 3)` returned 3 instead of 2.
2. **`median`** used `sort @_` (string comparison, e.g. 10 < 2) and picked `int(@sorted / 2)` — which was the wrong element (it averaged nothing; `@sorted / 2` on an array is just `@sorted`'s count in numeric context, but with a string sort the indices were wrong anyway). Fixed to numeric `sort { $a <=> $b }`, correct middle index for odd counts, and the average of the two middle values for even counts. Also added a guard for empty input.

`sh test.sh` now prints `PASS`.
